standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-not-.npc: Cleaning, cleaning, always cleaning. This apprenticeship isn't all that it was cracked up to be.
Oh, Aadeela, the sorceress upstairs, said she'd teach me magic, she did. And here I am scrubbing floors without a spell to help me.

options.text: I could cast a Water Blast or a Wind Blast spell?

steps.player: I could cast a Water Blast or a Wind Blast spell to hurry things along if you'd like?

steps.npc: No, no, she'd kill me or worse if she knew I was using Magic to do chores. Her last apprentice - well I'd rather not say.

steps.player: Oh go on, what happened to them?

steps.npc: They say she turned them into little spiders.

steps.player: Oh, that's too bad. I had better leave you to it.

options.text: Surely there must be upsides to the task?

steps.player: Surely there must be upsides to the task?

steps.npc: Nope. Clean this, clean that. When I'm finished cleaning here I have to go help out in the garden.

steps.player: What garden?

steps.npc: Oh, I shouldn't have told you.

steps.player: You're right, you shouldn't have.

steps.npc: Well, if you don't mind then, I'm busy and have to get back to work.

steps.player: Don't let me keep you.

options.text: Oh, you can talk to me. I can see you're having a bad day.

steps.player: Oh, you can talk to me. I can see you're having a bad day.

steps.npc: You know you're right. Nobody listens to me.

options.text: I can't blame them, all you do is whine.

steps.player: I can't blame them, all you do is whine.

steps.text: The apprentice is clearly hurt and ignores you.

options.text: A sympathetic ear can do wonders.

steps.player: A sympathetic ear can do wonders.

steps.npc: Yes, if I just let my frustrations out, I'd feel a lot better. Now what was I saying?

options.text: I don't know. You were whining about something or other.

steps.player: I don't know. You were whining about something or other. To tell you the truth, I wasn't really listening.

steps.text: The apprentice is clearly hurt and ignores you.

options.text: To tell you the truth, I wasn't really listening.

steps.player: To tell you the truth, I wasn't really listening.

steps.text: The apprentice is clearly hurt and ignores you.

options.text: You mentioned something about the garden.

steps.player: You mentioned something about the garden.

steps.npc: Oh yeah, that dreadful garden of hers.

steps.player: Where is it?
What do you mean?

steps.npc: Well it's here, but not really. You see the sorceress is trying out some new type of compression magic.

steps.player: Oh, that sounds interesting - so how does it work?

steps.npc: It would take too long to explain and, to be honest, I don't really understand how it works.

steps.player: Fair enough, but tell me, how do you get to the garden?

steps.npc: By magic! The sorceress did teach me one spell.

options.text: Wow, cast the spell on me. It will be good Magic training for you.

steps.player: Wow, cast the spell on me. It will be good Magic training for you.

steps.text: If the player has not talked to Osman about the Sorceress's Garden:

steps.npc: I can't do that now, I'm far too busy sweeping.

steps.text: If the player has talked to Osman about the Sorceress's Garden:

steps.player: Of course not. I'd be glad to help.

steps.npc: Okay, here goes! Remember, to return, just drink from the fountain.

options.text: Oh, that's nice. Well it's been great talking to you.

steps.player: Oh, that's nice. Well it's been great talking to you.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-been.player: Hey apprentice, do you want to try out your teleport skills again?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-been.npc: Okay, here goes - and remember, to return just drink from the fountain.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-been.text: If the player does not have a pet following them

steps.text: The player is teleported to the Sorceress's Garden

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-been.text: If the player has a pet following them

steps.npc: Oh, I'm sorry, could you pick up your follower first? I'm really not sure that I could teleport the both of you.

right-click-teleport-if-the-player-has-n.npc: I can't do that now, I'm far too busy sweeping.
